def transform(grid):
    # Horizontal bands have a single-cell break; the lower vertical markers identify
    # the columns through which each band extends upward.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker_cols = sorted({c for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0
                          and all(grid[rr][c] == 0 for rr in range(r))
                          and any(grid[rr][c] == grid[r][c] for rr in range(r+1,h))})
    # Use gaps in horizontal colored bars as the vertical extension columns.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        colors = [v for v in row if v]
        if len(colors) < 2:
            continue
        color = colors[0]
        occupied = [c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
        if len(set(colors)) != 1:
            continue
        lo, hi = min(occupied), max(occupied)
        gaps = [c for c in range(lo, hi+1) if row[c] == 0]
        for c in gaps:
            for rr in range(r):
                out[rr][c] = color
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
